rule: Direct objects (the thing acted on) use me, te, lo/la, nos, os, los/las. Indirect objects (to/for whom) use me, te, le, nos, os, les. They go before a conjugated verb: 'Lo vi.' 'Le di el libro.' With two pronouns, se replaces le/les before lo/la/los/las: 'Se lo di.'

examples.es: Vi la película. La vi ayer.
examples.en: I saw the film. I saw it yesterday.

examples.es: ¿El libro? Se lo di a Marta.
examples.en: The book? I gave it to Marta.

common_mistake: Using lo for people you give something to (indirect). 'I gave him the book' is 'Le di el libro', not 'Lo di el libro'.
